title: Matthew Brown discovers Immaculate Constellation on IntelLink server

tellings.quote: on a shared IntelLink server there was something misappropriately uploaded.
encountered this immaculate constellation document within the government and it talks about transmedium objects, UFOs going in and out of the water.
tellings.difference: Says the document describes transmedium UFOs going in and out of water, and credits Corbell and Knapp, but does not mention the IntelLink server.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Matthew Brown coming across the Immaculate Constellation document inside government.

as_told.title: Matthew Brown and the Immaculate Constellation document on transmedium UFOs

plain: A former government official named Matthew Brown is said to have found a secret document called Immaculate Constellation that had been wrongly uploaded to IntelLink, a shared computer network used by US intelligence agencies, sometime in the 2020s. Jeremy Corbell, who reports on UFOs, passes this on from Brown, and Michels adds, crediting Corbell and the journalist George Knapp, that the document talks about transmedium objects, meaning UFOs that move in and out of the water. If true, it would mean the government keeps a record of such craft that it has never made public.
